verdicts.explanation: The paper states the extrapolated room-temperature conductivity of the surface region after reaction is 1.27 × 10−3 S/m, obtained from MLFF-MD (500–900 K) in this work, so the computational origin, unit, and 300 K temperature are correct. All secondary fields are correctly null.

The same sentence gives the bulk-region value 2.15 × 10−4 S/m as the extrapolated room-temperature conductivity from this work's MLFF-MD, matching the bulk region (central seven Li layers) of the LPSC(100) slab. Origin, unit, and temperature are correct and secondary fields are null.
